HONDA ODYSSEY from $37,610

When you need seven seats (or even eight) full time, you often need to ditch the SUV and go for a solid people mover. A car like the Odyssey is today’s minivan. Not the sexiest car on the road, but practical, comfortable and solid enough to take a family beating. That said, the third row mysteriously lacks ISOFIX latches, so despite having anchorage points, baby seats in the back row are pretty much out of the question. When all the seats are up the boot space is a bit narrow, but deep enough to take a large load.

Sarah, mum of four boys, has driven an Odyssey for years. “It’s the best when you’ve got lots of kids and sporting commitments. There’s no way I could pack my four giant boys plus equipment into in a standard SUV.”
